skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Systematize foundational knowledge about data visualization techniques for qualitative and quantitative data.
Evaluate and explain models and results from dimensionality reduction techniques.
Implement Principal Component Analysis using statistical software.
Apply Correspondence Analysis to real-world datasets.
Conduct Multiple Correspondence Analysis on complex datasets.
Perform Canonical Correlation Analysis on multivariate data.
Demonstrate proficiency in using statistical software such as R.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate statistical models and results.
Work collaboratively to solve problems related to data analysis.
